A build, itemised

You will learn

Every stage from a spec to a bitstream, with its time, tool and hash.

A whole build from a t27 spec to an Artix-7 bitstream, written out like a shop receipt: each stage, the tool and its version, the time it took, and the sha256 of what it wrote. No Vivado anywhere. When a number on a receipt can be checked, anyone can rebuild it and compare the hash. The spec in the player is the command that re-runs the bench: what it execs, at which commit, with no help text of its own -- a tool card that says so plainly.

Try it

Read the receipt: which stage took the longest, and which tool ran it? In the spec frame, read HELP_LINE and ARGS: what one optional argument does tri x7-bench take, and what does DISPATCH say it actually execs?

Open the interactive lesson →

One real open-flow build itemised like a shop receipt: each stage from a t27 spec to an Artix-7 200T bitstream with its time, tool version, output size and sha256.
